name: Joplin-Server
description: Sync server for Joplin notes, with sharing and collaboration

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The PostgreSQL database with every synced note, notebook and attachment, and secrets.env with this install's own database password. Back it up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Joplin Server web UI and sync API, published on host as 6764

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: APP_BASE_URL
variables.description: Required. Replace YOUR-SERVER-IP with your server IP, like http://192.168.1.20:6764. Joplin Server sends browsers and the Joplin apps to this address. For a domain use https://notes.example.com.

variables.name: DEFAULT_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The password for the first admin, admin@localhost. Leave it empty and one is made for you: it is shown in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Only used on the very first start; change it later in Joplin Server itself.
